artifacts.summary: 7-phase repair of the extension lifecycle hook mechanism: object-schema resolver join, flat-deploy hook path resolution, observable-but-non-blocking rc channel, live verification call site in command-gate-out.sh, nine new regression cases, doc addition, and a new all-extensions hooks-path lint rule.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's source-store/deploy split, a regression suite that resolves its subject library deploy-tree-first (`.claude/scripts/X.sh`) with a source-store fallback will SILENTLY exercise stale code for any task that edits the source store, because `.claude/` is only regenerated by a separate operator action. New test cases written for a source-store change therefore report a misleading PASS against unchanged code. The two sound patterns: (a) a harness sanity grep for a marker string unique to the change, exiting 2 (environment error) with an actionable message -- the precedent in test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh's own `_task_dir` guard; or (b) a per-group source-store-FIRST resolution, sourced in a subshell so the suite-level functions are untouched, printing an INFO line naming which copy was exercised. Never leave the resolution order implicit when the test is the acceptance evidence for a source-store edit.
